messages:
claire: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem 16. We have 3 outstanding items: token recount, delayed-usage backfill, invoice corrections. Need owners + narrow ETAs.

dylan: I can own the recount. Will run a dry-run tonight 23:30 UTC. If diffs <0.3% proceed to apply on 2026-03-18.

mohit: I can take the backfill pipeline and monitoring. Plan: 10-account canary at 02:00 UTC then full run 04:00-05:30 UTC. Need the recount CSV before canary.

ops-bot: Task BILL-1201 created: token-recount-dryrun, assignee dylan, due 2026-03-16.

claire: Dylan please publish CSV column spec so Finance can auto-calc credits. Also include reason_code values.

dylan: CSV spec: account_id, window_start, window_end, expected_tokens, observed_tokens, delta, delta_pct, reason_code, run_id. reason_code values: delayed_ingest, parser_fix, duplicate_drop.

mohit: Backfill guardrails: snapshot target table before apply, enable dedupe-by-event-id, alert duplicate-write-rate >0.05%. Rollback is restore snapshot + cancel pipeline.

billing-bot: Task BILL-1202 created: invoice-crediting, depends_on BILL-1201, assignee claire, due 2026-03-20.

claire: TL;DR owners: recount (dylan) - dry-run 2026-03-15 23:30 UTC, apply 2026-03-18. schema/ingest patch (eng) - merge by 2026-03-16. backfill (mohit) - canary 02:00 UTC, full 04:00-05:30 UTC. invoice credits/messaging (claire) - within 72h post-apply. Reply with one-line ack + blockers.

dylan: ack 1 dylan - dry-run tonight; slight CI flakiness may push by 1h.

mohit: ack 1 mohit - waiting on ingest PR merge.

(archived for audit)
